title: StochBench：Lean 中随机过程的领域专用基准
summary: StochBench 是一个 Lean 4 基准，包含 450 道研究生级随机过程问题，涵盖马尔可夫链、鞅、布朗运动、随机微积分等 Mathlib 覆盖不足的领域。基于 Opus 4.8 的智能体在每题 15 分钟限制下达到 34.9% 的证明率，表明该基准对先进证明器仍具挑战性。
summary_en: StochBench is a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate-level stochastic-processes problems covering Markov chains, martingales, Brownian motion, and stochastic calculus—areas underrepresented in Mathlib. An Opus 4.8-based agent achieves a 34.9% proof rate under a 15-minute per-problem limit, showing the benchmark remains challenging for advanced provers.
